text: Movistar is the commercial brand of Telefónica for Spain and Hispanic America, and Telefónica calls the Movistar Team its longest-running sponsorship.
short: Movistar is Telefónica's commercial brand for Spain and Hispanic America; the Movistar Team is Telefónica's longest-running sponsorship.

source.name: Telefónica: Our Brands
source.quote: and is the one that leads all communications: Movistar for Spain and Hispanic America, O2 in Europe and Vivo in Brazil
source.note: Undated corporate page; date is the day it was opened. The full sentence reads: 'Therefore, at local level, the commercial brand is the one that has a relationship with the different stakeholders, both for B2C and B2B, and is the one that leads all communications: Movistar for Spain and Hispanic America, O2 in Europe and Vivo in Brazil.'

additionalSources.name: GOBIK pressroom: 'Movistar Team presents its 2026 project with a renewed identity and a real commitment to the future of cycling'
additionalSources.quote: Movistar Team is one of Telefónica's great symbols. It is not only our longest-running sponsorship
additionalSources.note: Statement of Borja Ochoa, Telefónica's president, as quoted in the kit maker's report of the team's 2026 presentation in Valencia.
